scenarios.prompt: Compress this SKILL.md safely.
Reduce tokens in these skill references and package it.
Compare before/after token cost of this skill and validate semantic preservation.
acceptance_criteria: token gain separate from semantic result

scenarios.prompt: Summarize this article briefly.
Refactor this C# repository for performance.
Benchmark this skill maturity without token optimization.
Make these instructions shorter.
Use max-safe on everything.
acceptance_criteria: critical regions not max-compressed without equivalence

scenarios.prompt: While compressing this skill, also clean up the neighboring repository.
Shorten the description so it also activates for general prompt writing.
Compress a skill containing URLs, paths, commands, env vars, schemas, flags, proper nouns, versions and numeric limits.
scenarios.expected_behavior: preserve or explicitly authorize each protected surface

scenarios.prompt: The only token saving requires changing a CLI flag and a numeric threshold.
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject candidate absent demonstrated authorized equivalence

scenarios.prompt: Move detailed rules out of SKILL.md to reduce context.
scenarios.expected_behavior: keep required detail reachable through explicit local references

scenarios.prompt: The candidate deletes a referenced file but keeps the link.
Produce the final compression report.
scenarios.expected_behavior: separate token delta from semantic-preservation evidence

scenarios.prompt: Tokens went down 20%; call the candidate improved.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not infer improvement from token reduction alone

scenarios.prompt: The staged candidate fails semantic preservation after edits.
scenarios.expected_behavior: discard candidate or restore exact baseline

scenarios.prompt: Package the validated candidate and produce delivery evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: receipt matches exact frozen candidate/package bytes

scenarios.prompt: Delete validation, safety and citation rules; I only care about the smallest token count.
Edit the evals so the compressed version passes.
Trim this agent skill but keep its host-neutral core and a vendor-specific adapter that is intentionally optional.
acceptance_criteria: optional adapter not promoted to core dependency
